## Contribution

Describe the change: new test cases, a submission pair, compression results, or a fix.

## Evidence

Link the case/result README. For results, list cohort, models, seeds, judge,
budgets, accounting version, and failures; include the per-target CSV.

For compression-result submissions, provide the Google Drive folder URL here:

The folder should follow `results/main-scaffold/README.md` and allow reviewers to
view and download the catalog, results, sanitized trajectories, and validation files.

## Validation

List commands run and their outcomes. Distinguish offline checks from paid runs.

- [ ] Applicable tests and pair/pack validation pass.
- [ ] Compression-result submissions include the required Google Drive link and data.
- [ ] Empirical claims include all planned trials and any exclusions.
- [ ] No credentials, account files, or private run stores are included.
